incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate (5xx) on /v1/generate detected by synthetic checks. Impact: spike in 500/502, P50 latency up ~30%. Routing to oncall Leslie.

Leslie (oncall): Acknowledged — looking now. Putting quick mitigation: route to canary model-variant and enable fallback to safe-model. Will post updates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Leslie (oncall): Quick triage finds errors correlated with kvcache eviction under high load. Logs show `kv_cache:evict failed: OOM` and allocator traces referencing the runtime. I'm going to throttle eviction concurrency to reduce pressure.

Emily (sre): Noted. Drop the exact command so I can monitor and verify dashboards.

Leslie (oncall): Ran on prod node-group `dedicated-gpu-1`:
```
rbxctl set runtime-config --group dedicated-gpu-1 --kv-evict-concurrency=2
rbxctl route set /v1/generate --fallback model-safe-v2 --threshold 0.9
```

Leslie (oncall): Error rate falling from ~30% -> 4% -> 0.8% after throttle and fallback. Paging @Pranav for handoff in ~15m.

Pranav: On it. I'll take over in ~12m. Heads-up to SRE: we should capture heap profiles for the affected nodes during eviction windows. Emily, can you enable low-overhead heap sampling?

Emily (sre): Enabling sampling now and adding a dashboard slice. Also created temporary alert: `kvcache.eviction.high_error_rate`. Dashboard: https://internal.rw/boards/incident/1789991110

Charlie (eng-runtime): From the logs I see the eviction path touches quantization buffers. There's a likely regression from `optimize/kv-balance` landed last week. Suggest rolling that change back in canary to confirm. If rollback is clean, prepare patch.

Leslie (oncall): Good hypothesis. Action items for post-incident: create a postmortem doc, schedule a 1h follow-up with eng, SRE, and PM, and create remediation tickets prioritized by severity. I'll kick off the tickets.

Liu (PM): Please include clear customer-impact metrics (which customers hit 5xx, request counts, duration) and whether any contractual SLA was at risk. Add customer-comms to the agenda.

Pranav: Handoff complete — Leslie leaving notes and moving to standby. I'll continue mitigation and lead RC steps. :thumbsup:

Leslie (oncall): Leaving the incident log entry with commands and timings. Moving to standby.

Pranav: Copying action items here so they're explicit for postmortem and triage: 
- ACTION A1 (sev: P1) Owner: Charlie. Rollback `optimize/kv-balance` in canary and validate across traffic slices. Est size: 1 day dev + 0.5 day QA.
- ACTION A2 (sev: P1) Owner: Charlie. Add defensive check to prevent `kv evict` OOM; on hit, fallback to disk spill and fail open for requests. Est size: 2 days.
- ACTION A3 (sev: P2) Owner: Emily. Add heap/profile sampling around eviction windows, add dashboard and automated retention (7d). Est size: 1 day.
- ACTION A4 (sev: P3) Owner: Leslie. Add runbook step & automation to throttle `kv-evict` and enable automatic route fallback when error rate > 5%. Est size: 0.5 day.
- ACTION A5 (sev: P2) Owner: Liu (PM). Customer communications + SLA analysis + draft copy for status page. Est size: 0.5 day.

Pranav: Process notes — tag all tickets with `incident:1789991110` and `sev:P1/P2`. High-severity items get immediate sprint placement; medium items go into the next planning cycle. For Q2 planning tie-in: propose we reserve 2 sprint-days for inference hardening and one automated regression in CI.

Liu (PM): Proposed postmortem: 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC, 1h. I've sent calendar invites to eng leads, SRE, product, & support. Please add any additional attendees.

Charlie (eng-runtime): Starting rollback in canary now. Will verify metrics in 10m and report success/failure.

Emily (sre): Watchlist for verification: error rate, tail latency, token cost delta, and heap/alloc trends during eviction windows. Also adding a CI regression job that simulates eviction under sustained load.

Pranav: If rollback looks good, we'll prepare a patch branch with fix + tests + changelog and run a canary rollout. Order of operations: fix -> tests -> canary -> full rollout. Priority: safety + correctness over perf for this patch.

Leslie (oncall): Final before handoff: customer-facing error rate now ~0.2%, no confirmed SLA breach yet. Emily to confirm once profiles are ingested. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident moved to active mitigation state. Postmortem doc created: https://docs.internal/postmortems/1789991110 (PM to own).

Pranav: Closing notes for thread: we'll include owners, sizing, target sprint, and acceptance criteria in postmortem. I'll maintain the triage board and move tickets into the 'urgent' column. Please add CC for any cross-functional reviewers.

Charlie (eng-runtime): Update: rollback validated in canary, metrics green. Creating patch branch now.

Emily (sre): Profiles uploaded. Heap hard OOM looks correlated with kv-evict concurrency spikes. Dashboard proof attached to postmortem doc.

Liu (PM): Thanks team — we'll cover communications and roadmap impacts in the postmortem meeting. Expect follow-up on priority for Q2 planning. :spiral_calendar_pad:
